articles.headline: Kick It Out: Discrimination 'deeply embedded' in football, reports up 25%
articles.description: Discrimination remains "deeply embedded" in English football, the chief executive of Kick It Out has said, with reports up 25%  last season compared to the prior campaign.

articles.headline: Ex-Arsenal midfielder Aaron Ramsey named Oxford United manager
articles.description: Aaron Ramsey has stepped into management by taking the reins at Oxford United.

articles.headline: Notts County beat David Beckham's Salford in League Two playoff final
articles.description: Sir David Beckham made an unhappy Wembley Stadium return as Notts County beat the Salford side he co-owns 3-0 to win the League Two playoff final.

article.headline: Sam Smith rescues Wrexham point vs. Cambridge but promotion boost missed
article.description: Sam Smith secured a point for Wrexham in a 2-2 draw against Cambridge United on Tuesday, as the League One promotion hopefuls missed out on a chance to extend their buffer over Wycombe Wanderers.
article.linkText: Smith rescues Wrexham point but L1 boost missed

article.story:
Sam Smith secured a point for Wrexham in a 2-2 draw against Cambridge United on Tuesday, as the League One promotion hopefuls missed out on a chance to extend their buffer over Wycombe Wanderers.

George Dobson put the visitors -- aiming for a third straight English league promotion -- in front after just four minutes, before goals from Liam Bennett and Josh Stokes either side of halftime put Cambridge ahead.

But Smith, a January signing from Reading, scored his third goal for Wrexham in the 57th minute to grab a point for Phil Parkinson's side.

With Wycombe drawing 0-0 at home to Shrewsbury Town, Wrexham remain second and three points ahead of the Buckinghamshire side. Only the top two in League One gain automatic promotion to the Championship.

Wrexham, who have played a game more than Wycombe, face relegation-threatened Burton Albion next.

There are only six games remaining in League One for the side owned by Ryan Reynolds and Rob McElhenney.
